title: OFISI YA TAIFA YA MASHITAKA YATAKIWA KUTUMIA MIFUMO YA TEHAMA KUIMARISHA UTOAJI HAKI KWA WANANCHI
why_not: Undated handover of the prosecution service's CMIS (by the office-holders named, 2023), saying it has begun exchanging data with the Police Force's systems through GovESB; that answers neither open gap (a police plan, the last twelve months) and names no police system, and the link to the prosecution is already held from 2024.
